findings.user_action: USB removed; GP9 grounded during USB-only power-on; jumper removed after 3 seconds
findings.pnp: Target USB serial node disconnected and returned; recorded absence window includes monitor polling and user sequence, not a precise startup latency
findings.schema: Byte-exact to power-cut-after baseline, 1387 bytes, CRC32 895336899

scope: Proves GP9 grounded-at-boot forced NORMAL selection on this board and unchanged persisted configuration after jumper removal. Does not prove IO4 cold-switch or game/input compatibility.
